review: Round4 post-settlement rental appeal decrease compensation design
scope: Isolated engineering only; no real PSP/commercial fee/legal policy change

constraints.title: 当前独立申诉决定来源
constraints.criterion: C04返回原义务/合同hash、owner、case最新version/decision hash、独立reviewer、目标保留额及isolated来源；旧/held/无历史lineage拒绝。

constraints.title: 非客户端金额授权
constraints.criterion: C11以当前C04决定与原root/capture决定差额；客户端只能传引用版本/摘要，无金额、payee、币种覆盖。

constraints.title: 仅减收不追收
constraints.criterion: 目标高于当前净收HOLD；等于净收返回只读no-op，不建零movement；更高决定不得回收已返补偿或新扣款。

constraints.title: 净收预算
constraints.criterion: 净收=原已确认capture−该capture已确认refund/compensation；多个申诉按当前净额，不能按原capture重复退。

constraints.title: 原资金图不改
constraints.criterion: 追加COMPENSATION/REFUND引用原capture并归同deposit root；原capture/release及accepted合同不改。

constraints.title: 账项严格反向
constraints.criterion: 新增反向分录对应原capture账户、币种和方向并同事务；legacy完整BUSINESS账户需匹配原账冲销，或受权治理前明确HOLD，不能误用RD账户冒充冲销。

constraints.title: 授权余额不复活
constraints.criterion: 补偿不增加remaining authorization；展示原扣款、累计补偿、净收、已释放分别计算，不让退款再次可扣。

constraints.title: UNKNOWN不造可信回执
constraints.criterion: 存在未确认movement、独立receipt缺失、orphan或账图损坏时HOLD；新补偿不是修复原UNKNOWN的手段。

constraints.title: 当前版本和并发
constraints.criterion: 同order锁下重验source/case/graph；review→execute变更拒绝；同决定重复仅一次资金，旧决定不能在新申诉后补执行。

constraints.title: 幂等不冲淡权限
constraints.criterion: 相同业务决定key绑定原capture+case/version/hash；不同参数冲突。Generic money入口仍须本域verified scope，不凭幂等历史绕过新动作许可。

constraints.title: 原子恢复
constraints.criterion: money movement/反向ledger/决定执行绑定同事务；故障/重启不留半确认或重复补偿。PG约束与锁需真实隔离PG举证。

constraints.title: 可用界面真实状态
constraints.criterion: 有权admin显式确认服务端只读差额，owner读真实money结果；丢回执先权威读回，未知不报已退，补偿完成不自动声称真实银行到账。

constraints.title: 独立权限维持
constraints.criterion: 供应商/owner/原裁决者不能自行产生所需独立申诉批准；C14/C13意见与admin按钮不替代来源及资金执行授权。

constraints.title: 既有来源过期处理
constraints.criterion: 已确认原capture的减收返还可以按明确安全释放规则处理已过期fixture，但不得因此允许新授权/正向扣款/复活撤销来源；历史合同绑定完整保留。

rule: These are scoped required checks linked to existing frozen obligations, not an unapproved replacement or denominator change of v1.1 305/1009.
source_observation: Existing rental_deposit_money._graph supports only AUTHORIZATION/CAPTURE/RELEASE and legacy capture-account read compatibility; unified_money_movement supports bounded cumulative refunds/compensation. New graph/UI must preserve source and account truth while extending this mechanism.
unknown_recovery: HOLD until independent trusted receipt source exists; never convert unknown to success by synthetic compensation.
independence: C14 read-only source/rules reviewer; C13 independent quality; final human deployment and C12 HK preflight roles unchanged.
